projects.title: Multi-Agent AI Customer Support System
projects.description: Created multi-agent AI system using Google ADK with Master Agent orchestration coordinating specialized Policy Agent (RAG) and Ticket Agent (database operations). Achieved 100% routing accuracy across 15+ test scenarios with sub-2-second response times. Implemented safety guardrails (PII protection, content moderation) and LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation framework. Published on GitHub (13 stars, 4 forks) and YouTube tutorials.

projects.title: Production-Ready ML & Cloud Infrastructure
projects.description: Maintained production-ready skillset: survival analysis (Cox PH, 0.6688 C-index on 28,800 patients), customer segmentation (Random Forest, 94.6% accuracy), LLM fine-tuning (LoRA on clinical notes). Deployed Qwen3.5 35B on AWS using Terraform, vLLM, and llama.cpp for self-hosted model inference.
